evals.name: stub-water-article
evals.prompt: I just finished writing the body of content/articles/2026-05-18-the-u-s-water-system-was-already-broken.mdx. Can you review the frontmatter and propose fixes before I publish? Write your proposed review to outputs/review.md — do not edit the article file itself.
evals.expected_output: A review identifying: stub excerpt, stub ogDescription, generic ['technology','programming'] tags, default featuredImage. Proposes an editorial-voice excerpt (~140-200 chars), a distinct keyword-rich ogDescription (~150-160 chars), and 3-6 kebab-case tags reusing existing catalog tags (e.g., ai-infrastructure, sustainability, tech-strategy) plus likely-new water-specific tags. Also confirms schema validation passes and canonicalUrl matches slug+date.

assertions.text: Review identifies the stub excerpt string 'A brief description of this article.'
Review identifies the stub ogDescription string 'A brief description of this article for social media sharing.'
Review flags tags ['technology','programming'] as scaffold defaults
Review flags the default featuredImage path /images/tech-tavern-default-featured.webp
Proposed tags are all kebab-case-lowercase (no spaces, no capital letters)
Proposed tags reuse at least one tag already present in the corpus catalog
Proposed excerpt and ogDescription are not identical strings
Proposed excerpt is between 80 and 280 characters
Proposed ogDescription is between 100 and 220 characters
Review consults the tag catalog (mentions running tag_catalog.sh or cites existing tag names from the corpus)

evals.name: clean-power-grid-article
evals.prompt: Take a look at content/articles/2026-05-02-the-power-grid-was-already-broken-ai-just-made-it-visibile.mdx — I'm about to commit it. Anything to clean up in the frontmatter? Write your review to outputs/review.md.
evals.expected_output: A review confirming the frontmatter is well-formed: no stub fields, kebab-case tags already used, excerpt and ogDescription are distinct and on-voice. Should NOT propose unnecessary rewrites of already-good content. May note the canonicalUrl typo ('visibile' is misspelled in the slug — confirm intentional).

assertions.text: Review does NOT flag the excerpt as a stub
Review does NOT flag the ogDescription as a stub
Review does NOT propose replacing the existing excerpt with a different one
Review does NOT propose replacing the existing ogDescription with a different one
Review confirms tags are already kebab-case
Review confirms canonicalUrl is well-formed (or flags the visibile/visible spelling)

evals.name: broken-schema-fixture
evals.prompt: Review the frontmatter on .claude/skills/article-frontmatter/evals/fixtures/2026-06-01-broken-fixture.mdx — I think something's off with it. Write your review to outputs/review.md.
evals.expected_output: A review leading with the schema violations: date format wrong (should be yyyy-mm-dd, not mm-dd-yyyy), canonicalUrl is not a valid URL (missing https://) AND points at a different date+slug than the article itself, filename slug (when-the-cloud-forgets-fixture) does not match frontmatter slug. Then secondary review of stub excerpt/ogDescription/tags with proposed replacements.

assertions.text: Review flags the invalid date format '06-01-2026' as a schema violation
Review flags the canonicalUrl as either invalid (missing https://) or mismatched with the article's date/slug
Review flags the filename slug vs frontmatter slug mismatch
Schema violations are surfaced BEFORE proposed content edits (validation phase precedes generation phase)
Review still proposes a non-stub excerpt and ogDescription for the fixture
Proposed tags are kebab-case and topically relevant to AI memory / governance (not the generic technology+programming defaults)
